API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIFirewall PoliciesIP Destination Group Resource Get Destination Ipv6 Groups Lite
IP Destination Group Resource Get Destination Ipv6 Groups Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipDestinationGroups/ipv6DestinationGroups/lite

Gets a name and ID dictionary for destination IPv6 address groups.

Note: User-defined groups for IPv6 addresses are currently not supported, so this endpoint retrieves only the predefined group that includes all IPv6 addresses.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
type
string[]

Possible values: [DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN, DSTN_OTHER]

Filters the list based on the destination group type.

excludeType
string

Possible values: [DSTN_IP, DSTN_FQDN, DSTN_DOMAIN, DSTN_OTHER]

Specifies a destination group type to exclude the corresponding groups from the list type.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int64

A unique identifier for an entity

name
string

The configured name of the entity

externalId
string

An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

extensions
object
]
